task.summary: Default task
Hid health bar on death in `AuraEnemyCharacter` and adjusted lifespan order in `Die`.
Replaced health bar visibility toggle with component destruction in `Die` method.
Added dissolve effect implementation to `AuraBaseCharacter` with timeline-driven material updates.
Added glow effect support to `AuraBaseCharacter` with timeline-driven material updates and reusable parameter update logic.
Added `MulticastHandleDeath` implementation to `AuraEnemyCharacter` for synchronized health bar destruction across clients.
Removed unused `SlateWrapperTypes` header from `AuraEnemyCharacter` and updated `.idea/workspace.xml` changes for consistency.

Added floating damage text system with `UAuraDamageTextComponent`. Integrated `ShowFloatingText` method in `AuraAttributeSet` and `ShowDamageNumber` in `AuraPlayerController` for displaying damage values.
Updated damage number logic to iterate through all player controllers, ensuring correct display for multiplayer scenarios.
Refactored `UAuraDamageTextComponent` initialization and updated `ShowDamageNumber` to improve component attachment logic. Marked `ShowDamageNumber` as `const`.
Updated `ShowFloatingText` call in `AuraAttributeSet` to display damage text for all damage instances, not just fatal damage.

Replaced `ShowFloatingText` with `GameplayCue` for damage text display and removed redundant logic in `AuraAttributeSet` and `AuraPlayerController`. Added `UAuraGCN_DamageText` to manage floating damage text.
Namespace `GameplayCue` updated to include `GameplayCue.Aura.DamageText` for improved organization and clarity. Adjusted `AuraAttributeSet` references accordingly.
Added `UAuraExecCalc_Damage` for custom damage calculations and updated project configuration files accordingly.
Added armor attribute capture to `UAuraExecCalc_Damage` for improved damage calculation support.
Added gameplay tag support to `UAuraExecCalc_Damage` and refined armor attribute calculation.
Updated `.idea/workspace.xml` to reflect changes in project configuration and added breakpoint in `AuraExecCalc_Damage.cpp`.
Refactored `UAuraExecCalc_Damage` to use `SetByCallerMagnitude` for damage calculation and removed redundant armor logic.
Added `BlockChance` attribute capture to `UAuraExecCalc_Damage` and incorporated block chance logic into damage calculations.
Refactored `UAuraGCN_DamageText` to improve target character resolution using `FGameplayCueParameters.Location` and simplified validation checks.

Added `AuraGCN_ProjectileFlight` and `AuraGCN_ProjectileImpact` gameplay cues for managing projectile flight audio and impact effects. Refactored `AuraProjectile` to use these cues, improving sound and effect handling.
Added projectile Gameplay Cue configuration to `AuraGA_ProjectileSpell` and `AuraProjectile`, allowing customizable flight and impact effects via gameplay tags.
Renamed a variable in `AuraProjectile` for clarity (`Owner` to `OwnerActor`).
Added `Fireball` gameplay tag namespace and associated Cues for flight and impact effects. Enhanced tag structure under `Projectile` for better organization.
Updated `.idea/workspace.xml` to include changes for Fireball gameplay cues and adjustments to projectile-related assets.
Added `ArmorPenetration` attribute capture to `UAuraExecCalc_Damage` and incorporated armor penetration into damage calculations.
Enabled `bUseDebugTargetFromHud` in `DefaultEngine.ini` for debugging ability system targets.
Moved `bUseDebugTargetFromHud` from `DefaultEngine.ini` to `DefaultGame.ini` to align with configuration standards.
Renamed `GetPlayerLevel` to `GetCharacterLevel` across all classes and interfaces. Enhanced damage calculations with level-based coefficients using `DamageCalcCoefficients` data.
Added comprehensive debug logging and null checks to `AuraExecCalc_Damage`. Enhanced armor and damage coefficient validation with detailed logging for level-based calculations.

Added critical hit calculations to `AuraExecCalc_Damage`, including support for `CriticalHitChance`, `CriticalHitDamage`, and `CriticalHitResistance`. Enhanced logging for detailed debugging of critical hit outcomes.
Refactored `AuraExecCalc_Damage` for improved readability, added block chance and armor mitigation debug sections, and refined critical hit resistance calculations.
Replaced `MagicResistance` attribute with `Luck` in `AuraAttributeSet` and updated related gameplay tags, replication logic, and damage calculation methods.
Refactored `AuraExecCalc_Damage` to simplify attribute captures with helper lambdas, incorporated `Luck` into critical hit and armor penetration calculations, and streamlined debug logging.
Added `Luck`-based attribute modifiers and effects for all character classes. Updated secondary attribute effect assets and UI to reflect changes.
Updated `.idea/workspace.xml` to remove outdated change references and synced project files.

Added `UAuraDamageCalcConfig` to centralize damage calculation parameters in `AuraExecCalc_Damage` and updated logic to use configuration values for block, armor mitigation, and critical hit calculations.
Made `UAuraExecCalc_Damage` `Blueprintable` and `BlueprintType`, updated `DamageConfig` to use `TObjectPtr`, and adjusted include order.

Added new Blueprint assets for damage calculation, including coefficient data (`CT_Aura_DamageCalcCoefficients`) and configurations (`DA_Aura_Damage_Default`, `DA_Aura_Damage_LuckBuild`), and updated project file references.

Added `UAuraExecCalc_Potion` for handling potion-based health and mana restoration, introduced new gameplay tags (`HealthRestoration`, `ManaRestoration`) in `AuraTags`, and updated `AuraGA_ProjectileSpell` for enhanced effect context handling.

Added `SetByCallerMagnitude` support to `AAuraEffectActor` for dynamic effect customization, refactored potion execution calculations to rely solely on `SetByCaller` values, and improved overlap-based effect application with streamlined policies.
Removed default value assignment for `SetByCallerMagnitudes` parameter in `ApplyEffectToTarget` for better compliance with usage patterns.
Expanded potion scaling in `UAuraExecCalc_Potion` with level, Vigor, and Intelligence bonuses. Added configuration properties for scaling customization and debug logging for restoration details.
Enhanced effect context in `AuraGA_ProjectileSpell` by associating abilities, projectiles, actors, and hit results. Fixed ability level usage in damage scaling.

Added validation for `ProjectileClass` and `DamageEffectClass` in `AuraGA_ProjectileSpell` to prevent invalid instantiation. Simplified `FTransform` initialization and removed unused variable `TestLevel`.
Added `FAuraGameplayEffectContext` with serialization support and helper methods for critical and blocked hit tracking.
Fixed inheritance syntax for `FAuraGameplayEffectContext` by adding `public` to ensure proper access specifier usage.
Added `const` qualifiers to `SetIsBlockedHit` and `SetIsCriticalHit` methods in `FAuraGameplayEffectContext` to ensure better type safety.
Refactored attribute clamping logic in `UAuraAttributeSet` by introducing reusable lambdas for improved readability and consistency.
Enhanced `FAuraGameplayEffectContext` serialization to include custom fields for critical and blocked hits. Improved bitmask handling for efficient data replication.
